paper.comparability: Primary figures retain the authored algorithms with semantically mapped built dials. No single paper g parameter represents the built Cluricaun event, and no original Bird CLI parameter represents Swallow duration; primary ratios therefore retain an explicit timing qualification. The supplemental diagnostic is separately labelled and never replaces the authored denominator.

conversion.birds: Sum original Game.snapshot active Attack+Health after auras, before Start of Combat. Eggs and the Lump's borrowed Nest stats are already included. The printed board total already excludes sky/away and hand bodies; do not add or subtract the separately printed sky.
conversion.fairies: Use original snapshot recruit total (rec), not combat (comb): this retains the printed Fetch body and occupied-slot Rings, removes the Start-of-Combat Fetch replacement/twin and Wisps on empty Ring slots. Per-round removed_start_effect_stats is comb minus rec. Built Fetch share 0.5 replaces authored default 1.0, though it changes only combat, not rec.

intentional_timing_differences.authored: +1 Ring size every third rainbow-complete End of Turn (g=1/3)
intentional_timing_differences.built: +1 Ring size after tier-up when every slot has a Ring (golden +2)
intentional_timing_differences.diagnostic_translation: Suppress only the periodic Cluricaun branch; apply built growth on each scripted tier-up.
intentional_timing_differences.source: docs/ideation/DECISIONS.md: Wave 1 review: calls on the asks, item 1

intentional_timing_differences.diagnostic_translation: Original fly action, then due round from the built ordinary/Swallow/golden-Tern trip dial.

not_modelled: Real shops, shared-pool depletion, heroes, opponent composition, survival selection and actual line-policy decisions.
Bird Jack Daw permanent carry uses a target-shape opponent proxy and floor rounding; Godot uses actual across stats and ceil.
Reel combat movement, holder keywords and answer damage do not enter the paper pre-start denominator.
The reconciliation changes the two listed timing rules only, not authored arrivals, budgets or all game rules.

out_text.birds: docs/ideation/content/pass3/birds-pass3-model.out.txt exists; rerun uses current model source and built mapped dials
out_text.fairies: No fairies-pass3-model.out.txt exists on this tree; tables in fairies-pass3.md are the archived printed figures

population: Committed seat of each assigned line only for line comparisons. Original tempo seat identity retained after its R7 switch. Surviving boards at each round; no zero imputation for eliminated seats.

seat_labels.final_source: players.csv strategy (never used for accounting grouping)

sole_criterion: Each written line real R12 median / paper pre-start board inside inclusive [0.5, 2]. Intervals reported; no additional bars.
uncertainty: 95% percentile bootstrap of all predeclared independent lobby seeds, including eliminated empty clusters; all seats/rounds kept together. Paper is a fixed authored plan, not estimated data.
